xModule.pricing: Counts: Recent $0.005 per request (one request returns 7 days of hourly/daily counts for one query); Posts: Read $0.005 per post returned
xModule.recommendation: counts/recent once per 3h for all 15 themes = $0.60/day (~$18/month); reading 20 posts per theme instead would be $12.00/day
xModule.assumes: one counts response per query (7 days of hourly buckets); if X paginates the cost scales with pages
xModule.note: Not called. Code is in lib/narratives.js xVelocity() (counts/recent, 15 theme queries per run); it runs only if X_ON is flipped in code AND NARRATIVES_X=1, after approval. It would share the existing X budget ($50/month cap).

method.attention: Attention velocity = average of log(theme share now / its own baseline) across available sources: Wikipedia pageviews (theme articles / Bitcoin+Ethereum+Cryptocurrency+Solana+XRP articles, last 7d vs prior 28d), Google News 7-day search (last 48h per-day vs earlier days, divided by the median across themes), and once history exists: share of crypto RSS headlines, of new launches, of DexScreener boosts vs earlier snapshots.
method.market: Market-cap share velocity = log(theme share of top-500 crypto market cap now / 7 days ago), from CoinGecko category coin lists (per-coin 7d/30d changes; stablecoins, wrapped and bridged tokens removed). Breadth = % of the theme's tokens (mcap >= $1M) up. TVL growth from DefiLlama protocol categories (L2s: chain TVL).
method.momentum: Momentum 0-100 = percentile across themes of: attention velocity 30, mcap-share velocity 7d 20, 30d 5, TVL growth 15, breadth 15, launch share 5, boost share 5, news share 5 (missing inputs drop out).
method.emerging: Emerging = attention velocity >= ln(1.5) (attention share up 50%+) AND attention velocity minus mcap-share velocity >= ln(1.3) (attention outrunning money) AND theme mcap not already doubled in 30d.
method.overcrowding: Caution/overcrowded (1 / 2+ triggers): supply glut (>=15% of all launches seen in 24h and >2x its news share), new entrants' median 24h return negative and 10pp below all new tokens or falling 15pp vs earlier snapshots, breadth deterioration (sector +25% in 30d but <40% of tokens up this week, or breadth down 25pp vs earlier snapshots).
